topics.topic: Behavior when no service instance is selected (are bindings/actions/models still available, and how reads are surfaced)
questions: When no instance is selected for a service, are proposing/accepting bindings for its operations allowed, or must they be refused?
When no instance is selected for a service, does ManifestOperation still exist as a readable model for that service operation, and is `base_url` absent or is reading refused?

quotes:
manifest (K-03). Read when a binding is proposed or accepted and every time the
operation is invoked, to check that the manifest record still has the pinned
digest (A08 rules 5–7).

each is absent when the installation selects no instance or that instance
  does not state it, and judging them is the invoker's (A09 rule 6), not the
  manifest reading's.
judgement.why: The text says no selected instance blocks invocation, while manifest reading for propose/accept still occurs and uses absent instance fields rather than refusing the read.

topics.topic: Authority required to resend a draft-write after a not_applied outcome (new EffectApproval vs flow activation authority)
questions: For a draft-write node resolved not_applied, must resend obtain a fresh EffectApproval, or can it resend under flow activation authority only?

topics.topic: How many requested EffectApprovals may exist per waiting effect point and how the active approvable one is chosen
questions: For one waiting effect point (run_id, node_id, map_index), how many approvals in status `requested` may exist at once, and how is the approvable one selected?

topics.topic: Idempotency of activate when the requested flow version is already active (reuse existing activation vs create new record)
questions: If the requested flow_version_id is already active, does the kernel create a new FlowActivation record or return the existing active one without writing?

topics.topic: Uniqueness/coexistence rules for accepted OperationBindings on the same service operation digest
questions: Can multiple accepted bindings for the same (service_id, operation_name, record_digest) coexist, including with identical ports, or must acceptance enforce uniqueness/replacement?

topics.topic: Whether a StandingGrant for a mapped node applies across all map_index executions
questions: When a granted node is mapped, does one StandingGrant cover all map_index executions of that node in runs pinned to that flow version?

topics.topic: Whether a proven read-only flow version auto-activates or requires an explicit activate action
questions: Does a proven read-only flow become active automatically at compose/prove time, or only when someone calls the activate action?

topics.topic: Whether non-token installation config changes apply live or only after restart
questions: For configuration fields other than tokens (for example `service_instances`, `manifest_revision`, listen address), do changes take effect without restart or only on restart?

topics.topic: Whether spooled-file reading is a distinct MCP operation or only expressible via existing fixed operations
questions: Is `read_spooled_file` a distinct MCP operation, or must spooled-file byte reading be expressed only through the already-listed fixed operations?

topics.topic: Which operation node classes are eligible for StandingGrant creation
questions: Can a standing grant be created for `read` or `draft-write` operation nodes (which do not stop for owner approval), or only for node classes that can actually wait for approval (`state-transition`, `external-effect`)?

topics.topic: Which principals are allowed to read implementation source bodies via inspect/repair
questions: Which principals may read implementation source bodies via inspect: owner, any agent, only may-author agents, or only in a repair-scoped call?
